selected_problem: Fresh canonical main publishes an Agent Task schema requiring id/title/status, a fixed status enum, bounded progress, and string evidence items, but TaskStore only validated that tasks.json was an array. Invalid durable items and invalid write-side replacements could therefore contradict the checked-in contract.（最新规范主仓已经发布 Agent Task schema，要求 id/title/status、固定状态枚举、0-1 进度以及字符串 evidence 条目，但 TaskStore 只验证 tasks.json 顶层是否为数组，因此无效持久化任务与写入侧替换仍可违反仓库内正式契约。）
selection_basis: The repository already defines the task item schema, so enforcing it at the store boundary closes contract/runtime drift without choosing a new task architecture.（仓库已经定义任务条目 schema，因此在存储边界执行它是在闭合契约/运行时漂移，不需要选择新的任务架构。）
TaskStore.plan already emits task objects that satisfy these constraints.（TaskStore.plan 当前生成的任务对象本身已经满足这些约束。）

changes: Validate required task fields and the published status enum on durable reads and writes.（在持久化读取与写入边界验证必需任务字段和已发布状态枚举。）
Validate optional progress bounds and evidence string-item semantics exactly as published.（按已发布契约验证可选 progress 边界和 evidence 字符串条目语义。）
Preserve additional runtime task fields such as runId, phase, detail, and mode.（保持 runId、phase、detail、mode 等运行时附加字段不变。）

truth_boundary: This cycle enforces the already-published Agent Task item contract only. It does not redefine task phases, scheduling policy, or product workflow.（本轮只执行已经发布的 Agent Task 条目契约；不重新定义任务阶段、调度政策或产品工作流。）
